Excellent.prompt: Write a Python function 'validate_email(email: str) -> Tuple[bool, str]' that validates email format using RFC 5322 standard. Return (True, '') for valid emails, (False, error_message) for invalid. Handle: multiple @, spaces, non-ASCII, null input. Include docstring with 3 examples.

Create a 2-page executive summary of the Q3 financial report for board directors. Include: revenue growth %, profit margin, key metrics by business unit, top 3 risks, 3 strategic recommendations. Use bullets for data, sections with headers.

Build a GraphQL API using Apollo Server with User and Post types. Implement queries: getUser(id), getPosts(limit, offset). Mutations: createPost, deletePost. Auth: JWT bearer token. Error handling: custom error codes. Rate limit: 100 req/min. Deployment: Docker.

Conduct a competitive analysis of B2B project management tools (Asana, Monday.com, Jira, ClickUp) for the US market in 2024. Compare: pricing, features, integrations, customer reviews (G2 scores), target segments. Output: 20-page report with feature matrix, pricing comparison chart, strengths/weaknesses table, recommendation for each customer type.

Develop a comprehensive 24-month product roadmap for an AI customer service platform. Phase 1 (mo 1-6): MVP chatbot + ticket routing. Phase 2 (mo 7-12): sentiment analysis + integrations. Phase 3 (mo 13-18): predictive routing + multilingual. Phase 4 (mo 19-24): custom models + white-label. Include per-phase: features, metrics, resources, dependencies, risks.

Excellent.prompt: Write a 1500-2000 word technical blog post for 'Advanced React Patterns' blog targeting mid-level React developers (1-2 yrs experience). Cover: component composition patterns, custom hooks, render props vs. function components. Include: 4 code examples with explanations, 2 diagrams showing architecture, performance tips, common pitfalls.

Create a Python CLI script using Pandas and Matplotlib. Input: CSV with quarterly sales by region, product category. Processing: filter Q3-Q4 2025, group by region+category, calculate: total revenue, YoY growth %, top 3 products per region. Output: CSV with structured results + PNG chart (bar chart: revenue by region).

Research AI job market: 3 geographic regions (US, EU, APAC), time period 2023-2026. Find for each role (ML Engineer, Data Scientist, AI Product Manager): salary ranges (P25, P50, P75), experience requirements, top 20 companies by hiring volume, skill rankings. Data: LinkedIn Salary, Glassdoor, Levels.fyi. Output: 15-page report with regional comparison charts, talent acquisition insights.

Build a React web app for team task management. Features: create/assign/edit/delete tasks, 3 priority levels (high/medium/low), due dates (date picker), status tracking (not started/in progress/done), team member assignments, task dependencies, comments/notes per task. Tech: React 18+, TypeScript, React Query, Tailwind CSS. Backend: Node.js/Express + PostgreSQL. Auth: JWT.

Plan LinkedIn content marketing for Q4 2025: 90-day campaign targeting C-level executives (VP/Director/C-suite) and senior architects. Posting: 3x/week (Mon/Wed/Fri 8am EST). Content mix: 40% thought leadership, 35% company news/product, 20% industry insights, 5% recruitment. Metrics tracked: engagement rate (target 3-5%), follower growth (target 15% q-o-q), click-through rate to website.

Excellent.prompt: Build a payment processing API for an e-commerce platform (managed, >5000 transactions/day). Requirements: Stripe integration, support credit/debit/digital wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay), PCI DSS Level 1 compliance, handle payment failures (retries), dispute resolution, refunds, webhook notifications. Regulation: PCI DSS, state money transmitter laws, AML/KYC for large transactions (>$5K).

Create landing page content for a B2B SaaS marketing automation platform targeting marketing teams at mid-market companies (100-5000 employees). Pain points: lead nurturing inefficiency, manual email campaigns, poor lead scoring, limited analytics. Positioning: vs. HubSpot (price), vs. Marketo (ease-of-use). Decision-makers: CMO, VP Marketing.

Analyze generative AI startups funded 2024-2025 (US and EU). Focus: funding amount/round, technology differentiation, target verticals (healthcare, finance, legal), competitive positioning vs. OpenAI/Anthropic/Google, unit economics, go-to-market strategy. Context: VC landscape shift towards open-source alternatives, regulatory pressures (EU AI Act), enterprise adoption rates.

Optimize React web app (grocery delivery platform, on-the-go ordering) for mobile users. Context: 60% traffic from mobile, peak hours 6-8pm, users on 4G (avg 10 Mbps, 50ms latency), 40% new users unfamiliar with app. Current issues: image-heavy (3MB+ bundles), slow initial load (5s LCP), poor offline support.
Excellent.issue: Excellent contextual details about user behavior

Excellent.prompt: Research DevOps practices adoption by enterprise teams (500-50K employees) transitioning from waterfall/slow release cycles (quarterly) to agile/fast releases (weekly or daily). Context: legacy on-premise infrastructure, security/compliance concerns (SOC 2, HIPAA), distributed teams across regions. Challenges: tooling complexity, cultural resistance, skill gaps, deployment automation.

Excellent.prompt: Write a 1500-2000 word technical blog post on transformer neural networks for developers with Python experience. Include: (1) attention mechanism explanation with diagram, (2) self-attention and multi-head attention, (3) encoder-decoder structure, (4) 3 production code examples (PyTorch), (5) use cases (NLP, vision, multimodal), (6) performance considerations, (7) recent advances (Vision Transformers, Multimodal). Tone: professional but accessible. Target: Software engineers new to ML.
Excellent.issue: Excellent completeness with all aspects covered

Excellent.prompt: Create a production-ready FastAPI Python REST API for authentication. Features: user registration (email validation), login (email/password), JWT token generation (15min access, 7day refresh), password hashing (bcrypt), password reset via email, role-based access control (user/admin). Database: PostgreSQL with user schema. Security: CORS (localhost:3000), rate limiting (5 req/min), HTTPS required. Error handling: 400/401/403/429 codes with descriptive messages. Include: requirements.txt, .env.example, integration tests, deployment Docker.
Excellent.issue: Excellent completeness with all production aspects

Excellent.prompt: Research AI adoption in healthcare 2024-2025 across 3 regions (US, EU, APAC). Cover per region: diagnostic imaging (radiology, pathology), clinical decision support (oncology, cardiology), administrative automation (billing, scheduling). Metrics: adoption %,  vendor market share, patient outcome impacts. Regulatory: FDA, EU MDR, PMDA. Challenges: data privacy (HIPAA, GDPR), clinical validation, reimbursement models. Data sources: Gartner, IDC, company reports, peer-reviewed studies. Output: 25-page report with regional comparisons, forecasts 2025-2030.
Excellent.issue: Excellent completeness with all dimensions covered

Excellent.prompt: Optimize PostgreSQL database for data pipeline (1M records, 10 complex joins, avg 3-5 sec queries, target <500ms). Approach: (1) analyze query execution plans (EXPLAIN), (2) add B-tree indexes on join/filter columns, (3) implement materialized views for aggregations, (4) partition large tables by date, (5) add connection pooling (PgBouncer), (6) enable query caching (Redis), (7) update table statistics (ANALYZE). Constraints: read-only access to prod, max 2GB memory. Deliverables: optimized SQL, index strategy, caching architecture, benchmark before/after, monitoring alerts.
Excellent.issue: Excellent completeness with architecture and monitoring

Excellent.prompt: Plan Q4 2025 Instagram campaign for B2B SaaS (team productivity tool) targeting CTOs and VP Engineering. Strategy: Post 3x/week (Mon/Wed/Fri 9am EST). Content mix: 40% product features + use cases, 30% company culture/hiring, 20% industry insights, 10% user success stories. Use 10-15 branded hashtags. Link to blog (traffic goal: 500 clicks). Engagement KPIs: 3-5% like rate, 0.5% comment rate, 2% save rate. Influencer partnerships: 3-5 tech influencers (10K-50K followers). Budget: $5K paid promotion. Analytics: weekly dashboards tracking reach, engagement, click-through rate, follower growth.
Excellent.issue: Excellent completeness with strategy and measurement

Excellent.prompt: Build a weather app (iOS/Android via React Native). Requirements: (1) Real-time current conditions (temp, humidity, wind), (2) 7-day forecast with hourly breakdown, (3) weather alerts (extreme temperatures, storms), (4) location search via geocoding, (5) save 5+ favorite locations, (6) unit toggle (F/C), (7) push notifications, (8) offline mode (cache last 7 days), (9) light/dark mode auto-sync to system. Data: OpenWeatherMap API. UI: material design. Performance: <2s load time.

Create Python ETL script for monthly sales processing. Input: sales CSV (transaction_date, product_id, product_name, quantity, unit_price). Requirements: (1) validate data (required fields, data types), (2) aggregate by product (sum quantity, calculate total revenue=qty*price, margin = revenue * margin%), (3) rank top 10 products by revenue, (4) export to CSV with headers, (5) generate PDF report with pie chart (revenue by product), (6) handle duplicates (log warnings), (7) error handling (skip invalid rows, log to file).
Excellent.issue: Excellent, detailed requirements with edge cases

Excellent.prompt: Analyze 1000+ customer support tickets (text). Extract: (1) sentiment (positive/negative/neutral with confidence >80%), (2) topics/themes (using NLP, top 15 categories), (3) common issues (>10% frequency). Output: (1) interactive dashboard (Plotly) with sentiment distribution, topic breakdown, issue timeline, (2) CSV export of classified tickets, (3) agent performance summary (response time, resolution rate, CSAT). Visualizations: sentiment pie chart, issue frequency bar chart, topic word cloud, time-series resolution rate.
Excellent.issue: Excellent requirements with specific output formats

Excellent.prompt: Plan 12-month product roadmap with: (1) quarterly objectives tied to revenue/user goals, (2) features per quarter with story points and effort (man-days), (3) resource allocation (eng FTEs, design, PM hours), (4) success metrics (DAU growth, feature adoption, revenue impact), (5) dependency mapping between features, (6) risk assessment (3-5 risks per quarter with mitigation), (7) contingency plan for resource shortage, (8) post-launch validation approach. Output: Gantt chart, effort vs. impact matrix, resource utilization chart.
Excellent.issue: Excellent comprehensive requirements with risk planning

Excellent.prompt: Write blog series: 3 articles (1500-2000 words each) on SaaS customer lifecycle (acquisition, retention, expansion). For each: (1) best practices (cite 3 studies), (2) 2 detailed case studies with metrics, (3) 5+ actionable tips (with examples), (4) common mistakes, (5) resource recommendations. Target: B2B marketing managers (2-5 years). Format: markdown with H2 headers, code blocks for case studies, bold key terms. SEO: include 3-5 keywords per article. Publish timeline: weekly (Tue 9am EST). Promotion: cross-post to LinkedIn with unique hooks.
Excellent.issue: Excellent requirements with SEO, audience, and publication strategy
